purpose: prospective truth-blind repair of iteration-28 near-duplicate optimizer proposals while preserving its frozen RF model and search direction

frozen_model.profiled_nuisance: per-track TRAIN mean CFO at each rate
frozen_model.energy: pseudo-Huber with 250 Hz scale plus frozen Gaussian rate prior
frozen_model.score: cap-800 squared TRAIN RMS; occupied-second track weight; equal sessions within group

search.direction_source: sealed iteration-28 direction checkpoint reused bit-for-bit after full binding validation
search.proposal_rule: accept a safeguarded parabola only when at least max(12.20703125 m, 0.125 times current bracket width) from every evaluated scalar coordinate and from the current center; otherwise choose the deterministic golden subdivision with maximum separation, falling back to the midpoint of the largest interval
search.convergence_rule: only the declared adjacent-neighbour bracket width <=97.65625 m can converge; a near-duplicate proposal never counts as convergence
search.decision_gap_rule: require numerical decision gaps only among contenders separated by at least the current resolution threshold; duplicate-resolution contenders are one equivalence cluster

reuse.iteration28_cells: reuse only coordinates with raw-bit keys, finite values, exact model/cache bindings, matching inference cells digest, valid file seals, and no truth/HELD; every reused row is marked
reuse.new_cells: evaluate through the exact iteration-27 phase-state cache and material-node audit

numerical_gates.meaningfully_separated_decision_gap: greater than max(1e-10, 10 times maximum absolute atlas-direct pooled-score discrepancy among resolution-separated contenders)

coordinates.local_frame: WGS84 ECEF-derived ENU at iteration-27 anchor

paired_ds3.policy: every DS1 iteration emits an explicit DS3 companion status bound to the historical backfill harness

qualification.sub_km_claim: qualified RF estimate and post-seal error strictly below 1 km
